utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still a little behind—what mystery are they reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit behind too, so I don’t have the title handy yet. Let me check and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that—no rush, just let me know when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I was thinking 7 PM at the community center this Thursday — does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, 7 PM this Thursday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to remind you, Noah—just let me know the date when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I just need to find the date, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — just send it my way when you find it, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — could you remind me of the title and where we’re picking it up? I’m still a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the group and send you the title and pickup spot soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that would be great. I’ll keep an eye out for your message and head over once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Kira — I’m happy to go with a cozy pick, and I can help with snacks or chairs if needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the meeting time again? I want to make sure I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — just send me the time you have, and I’ll confirm it with the group.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep a spot for you, Ira. I’m just locking in the meeting time, then I’ll send everyone the invite.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — just send me the time when it’s set, and I’ll be there after my errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send the time as soon as it’s set, and I’m glad you can make it after your errands!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I will — hopefully it’s something easy to find for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — easy to find would be ideal.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thursday at the community center sounds great — I’ll help spread the word so everyone feels welcome!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you remind me of the book title and start time too? I just want to double-check the details before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll grab the book title and start time for you, and make sure you’ve got the latest details. Happy to help get everyone included!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey — I’m glad you’re here. I’m still gathering the book club details, and I’ll send out a cozy pick plus the time and place once I’ve got it set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — just let me know when you’ve got the pick and timing. I’m still hoping it works out, depending on what you choose.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Rey — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I’ve got the pick and timing set, and I’ll make sure it’s something cozy and easy to join in on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and see what titles are floating about—hopefully they pick something easy to find.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d be kind of you, Tess. I’d appreciate anything that’s easy to find.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll do some asking around and let you know what I hear—hopefully we can find a title everyone can get without a fuss.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I should be there around 6 o’clock, Mina. I’ll bring the chairs and thermos, just as planned.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, 6 works for me. Thanks for bringing the chairs and thermos, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the title and meeting time when you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’ll check and send you the title and meeting time as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for it this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure — I’m still pinning down the meeting time, and as soon as it’s set I’ll send the invite to everyone, including you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the time once it’s locked in?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll confirm it as soon as it’s locked in and send you the invite right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, have you heard what book we’re reading this month? I’m still waiting on the pick before I can say much more.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the group and let you know the book club pick soon, and I’ll also see if we need snacks or extra chairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’d appreciate that. Just let me know when you hear, and I can help with whatever else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep it simple and let you know the plan for book club.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli — I appreciate it. Just let me know once the plan’s set, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Rey — I’ll set the plan and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d appreciate that, thanks. Just let me know the title and meeting time when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll check the school schedule tonight and send you the title plus a couple of good meeting options.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — I appreciate you checking. I’ll wait for the title and meeting options so I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a bit behind on the updates—what are you all reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m blanking on the title—can you remind me?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No problem—I’d love the title if you remember it, since I’m still catching up on the neighborhood updates.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m happy to help spread the word and keep everyone in the loop. If you want, I can share the book title too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — that’d be great. I’m still catching up, so the title would really help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — we’re reading a mystery novel this month, and it’s supposed to be pretty twisty and fun. I can send you the title details so you’re all set!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — we’re on The Silent Patient. I might still need a reminder about when the next meeting is.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure of the exact date either, but I can check so we don’t miss it. And hopefully the book’s easy to find for anyone who still needs a copy.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Pia — that’d be great. I’d really appreciate a reminder once you find the date.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—Leo, we’re meeting at the community center this Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Leo — I’ll bring the sign-up list, so just look for me at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’d still like to come by if there’s room.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’m still checking the book club details, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have room info.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and see if anyone’s heard what titles are floating about. Hopefully they choose something easy to get hold of this time!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — keep me posted if you hear anything. I’d like to know before the meeting so I can pick it up too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything. Hopefully it’s an easy one to find!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still a little fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to pick it up if you remind me the title and where to go.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — I’ll check with the group and send you the title and details soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for your message and head over once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help, Mara—just let me know what the book club needs and I’ll see what I can lend a hand with.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — we’re trying to pick the next meeting time first, and then we’ll send out the invite. If you have any evening suggestions, I’d be glad to hear them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Evenings after 6 usually work well for me, Mara — Tuesday or Thursday could be a nice fit for the book club.

injected.text: Update: the book club has been moved from Tuesday at the library to Thursday at the cafe.
